records.observation: Low-level record dump, constructor only Object. main requires exactly one argument else diagnostic and exit0; opens InputLog and prints preamble. Allocates reusable header and all ten body records; reads and prints header before inspecting type. Types2-11 read and print state/event/constant/bare/cargo/message/collective/communicator/source/time-shift bodies respectively, unlike conversion paths that skip several of these. No event matching, category/ID mapping or numerical time correction. Type1 prints End Of Block and type0 prints End Of File, but BOTH return to getBlockStream: type0 is not overall termination. Physical EOF/short last block handling inherited from InputLog. Read return0 is not checked before printing or dispatch, so partial/stale record state can be displayed; header type retained after failed read can continue wrong dispatch. Unknown types log without consuming known body length or resynchronizing. Claimed total adds signed-int header/body return lengths only; excludes preamble, block padding, discarded final fragment and may overflow; not actual file bytes. Normal EOF closes then prints total; no catch/finally or integrity/time-order gate. Archived program not executed.

records.observation: Static initializer loads native TraceInput before assigning help text, so even help/main requires native load; native bodies remain outside this reading. Empty constructor only Object. parse resets time-check false; -tc enables it, help aliases print usage and append -h into native input specification without exiting. Other options and positional tokens append with spaces then trim; token boundaries/quoting are not preserved. No args yields empty non-null string, bypassing null-only missing-filename check. Array-index/number exceptions are logged and parsing falls through with accumulated specification; ordinal helper only handles 1/2/3 specially, all others th. main uses native-backed InputLog and reference Kind dispatch. Topologies create shadow categories in category and topology maps and print both; categories overwrite index keys and print, YCoordMap prints only. Primitive and Composite resolveCategory return is discarded; each counts as one long drawable (composite children not individually counted), prints BEFORE optional checks. -tc calls isTimeOrdered then compares previous end time with current using dcmpl; failure logs and exit1, equal times permitted, NaN operand produces comparison1 and rejects at this comparison if reached. One shared previous drawable/endtime across primitive/composite, initialized negative infinity; previous count initialized -2147483648L and object null. No -tc means no time checks or previous update. Unknown kind logs then peeks again without consuming via getNext, so progress depends on native peek behavior. EOF closes but discards boolean close result, reports count and open/read timings; no finally, sort or output SLOG2. Native correctness and successful runtime execution are not established.
